name: TensorPM v1.46.3
body:
# Changelog - v1.46.3

This patch makes PDFs readable again on Windows, fixes the detached task card that opened as an
empty window, and makes a folder full of new files quicker to review in the Distiller.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **PDFs can be read again on Windows:** since 1.46.0, TensorPM on Windows could not read any PDF.
  Adding one to a new project ended with "could not be read and was not added", and a PDF attached
  in the chat could not be summarized. PDFs are read again, in the documents step, in the chat, in
  the file preview and in the Distiller. macOS and Linux were not affected.
- **The detached task card shows the task again:** the button at the top right of a card in the
  **Order** view opens the card as a small window of its own. That window came up empty. It now
  shows the card, in your language.
- **AI errors you can read:** when the TensorPM AI service could not process a request, the chat
  showed the provider's raw answer, a block of technical text. It now says in plain words what
  happened and what to do. The copy button still gives you the full technical text for a bug
  report.
- **Settings sit flush against the compact sidebar:** with the compact sidebar switched on, the
  settings panel and the connector overview opened with a gap beside the sidebar.
- **The agent terminal window shows its texts:** two messages in the separate terminal window of a
  local coding agent appeared as internal names instead of text.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- **One "no" for a whole folder:** when the Distiller asks whether a file belongs to the project
  and more files from the same folder are waiting, the card offers **No for all in this folder**.
  The other files move to **Ignored Signals**, where you can bring them back, and the Distiller
  goes on with the next signal outside the folder. Files that arrive in the folder later are still
  reviewed.
- **Folders with many new files, before you start:** the Distiller's start screen now names
  folders that hold a batch of new signals and lets you ignore such a folder in one step, as the
  signal inbox already did.
- **A shorter list of results:** in the signal inbox, the result of a signal that was closed
  without a proposal now reads in your language ("Rejected in review") instead of a fixed English
  sentence. Several such results in a row fold into one line that opens on click.

## 📝 Notes

- No action needed. The update installs like any other.

---
